target_customer: Businesses producing or hosting lots of video, and bilingual freelancers who do translation or voice-over work
problem: Translating and voicing videos in other languages was slow and costly. Dubjoy was a marketplace and tooling for translators and voice actors.
business_model: Marketplace and service for video translation and voice-over

founders.name: Robert Farazin
founders.background_notes: YC page lists tvbeat as his other venture.

founders.name: Rok Gregoric
founders.background_notes: YC page: developer with 15 years in the Apple ecosystem, apps for over 30 companies, helped launch Layer.

technical_complexity.rationale: A workflow for translation, recording and syncing audio to video needed media tooling and a two-sided marketplace, moderate for the time.

defensibility.rationale: A marketplace of translators could build supply side lock-in but nothing in sources shows it did.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found in sources.

market_need_then: The YC page cites businesses with large volumes of video needing global reach; no dated demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: dubjoy.com now redirects to a GoDaddy for sale page

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand assets found; branding search returned only unrelated names.

outcome_analysis: Dubjoy's cause of inactivity is not public: no shutdown post, post-mortem, funding news or dated press was found. The YC directory lists it as inactive with a team of two, and its domain is now parked for sale. No failure factors are assigned because no source explains the outcome.
notes: Competitors list is empty: searches for dated 2011 rivals (Amara, dotsub, Gengo) returned nothing about Dubjoy and no dated competitor sources. Funding searches found no Dubjoy round. A Shyft page describing a 3595 dollar AI voice product appears unrelated and was not used. The GoDaddy for sale page was not fetched; the redirect target was seen in the fetch response. Searches show the funding rounds mentioned for similar names (Dubformer, Dubverse) are other companies.
